title: Underived exchange is invertible for universal-homeomorphism base changes
statement:
Let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
 f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
 Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y\end{array}
$$
be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] in which $g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$ are universal homeomorphisms [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$, the canonical underived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange]
$\gamma_F:g^{-1}f_*F\to f'_*g'^{-1}F$ is an isomorphism. More precisely, after applying $g_*$, the exchange satisfies
$$g_*(\gamma_F)\circ\eta_{g,f_*F}=f_*(\eta_{g',F}),$$
using the direct images of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the canonical composition isomorphism $d_{f,g'}\circ d_{g,f'}^{-1}:g_*f'_*\xrightarrow{\sim}(g\circ f')_*=(f\circ g')_*\xrightarrow{\sim}f_*g'_*$ built from the isomorphisms $d_{u,v}:(u\circ v)_*\xrightarrow{\sim}u_*v_*$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (1) (implicit on the left side of the equation), and where $\eta$ denotes the inverse-image/direct-image unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Tag 0F1C, proof of lemma-base-change-field-extension, perfect-closure reduction; Proposition topological invariance (Tag 03SI), with the exchange map written using the section formula of the project statement

proof.text: Apply [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] to the two horizontal maps g and g'. It says that a universal homeomorphism induces an equivalence of small etale sheaf categories compatible with inverse and direct images. Since inverse image is left adjoint to direct image by [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], the corresponding units eta_g:F→g_*g^{-1}F and eta_{g',F}:F→g'_*g'^{-1}F are isomorphisms (the direct images are quasi-inverses).

source.place: Tag 03SI, proposition-topological-invariance; the equivalence and its inverse/direct-image compatibility

proof.text: Let V→Y' be etale. By [lem-weil-pbc-underived-exchange-sectionwise], the component of gamma_F on V sends a representative given by W→Y and s∈F(X×_YW) to the restriction of s on X'×_{Y'}V. Apply g_* and precompose with eta_{g,f_*F}. Fix an etale W→Y and s∈(f_*F)(W)=F(X×_YW). The unit eta_{g,f_*F} of the sheafified presheaf inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] sends s to the class over W×_YY' of the representative (W, id_{W×_YY'}, s); likewise eta_{g',F} sends s∈F(U), U=X×_YW, to the class over U×_XX' of (U, id, s). By the sectionwise description with V=W×_YY', gamma_F sends the first class to the restriction of s along X'×_{Y'}(W×_YY')→X×_YW, a section of g'^{-1}F. Under the canonical composition identification d_{f,g'}∘d_{g,f'}^{-1}:g_*f'_*≅f_*g'_* (the isomorphisms d of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (1), with their coherences from [lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-composition-coherence]), which on W is F applied to the canonical isomorphisms (W×_YY')×_{Y'}X'≅W×_YX'≅(X×_YW)×_XX' of objects of X'_Et, this sends s to the same section obtained by applying the unit eta_{g',F} and then f_*. The direct-image formula in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] makes this equality sectionwise; representatives agree after a common etale refinement, so it is an equality of sheaf maps. Hence g_*(gamma_F)∘eta_{g,f_*F}=f_*(eta_{g',F}).

source.place: Tag 0F1C, perfect-closure reduction, using the section formula for the exchange; Tag 03SI, unit compatibility

proof.text: The right side of the equation in Step 2 is an isomorphism because eta_{g',F} is an isomorphism by Step 1 and f_* is a functor. Therefore g_*(gamma_F) is an isomorphism by two-out-of-three, since eta_{g,f_*F} is also an isomorphism. The equivalence induced by g in Step 1 is conservative, so its direct image g_* reflects isomorphisms; consequently gamma_F itself is an isomorphism.
